description: Documented decisions for developers/audit/audit.js and developers/tests/repo-integrity.js. rules: class of files by glob from the repository root (** any depth, * inside one folder; first match wins); GENERATED, DEVELOPMENT and COMPATIBILITY always apply, HISTORICAL only when no active file uses the file. historicalRoots: old pages and snapshots kept for history (their own references make files HISTORICAL, not ACTIVE); developers/i18n/scan-config.json 'archived' is read as well. missingAllowed: references to missing files that are known, with the reason ('from' is a file or glob, 'repo:file' for another repository; 'paths' the missing site paths); defect: true marks a real broken link still to fix. repo-integrity.js fails on any other reference to a missing file. integrityIgnoreSources: files whose references are not checked at all. dynamicBases: a folder base in a script that the scan reads as 'folder/' + any name, while every use adds a known subfolder: it is narrowed to narrowTo (dropped without it), so files of that folder are not all UNKNOWN; repo-integrity notes an entry that matches nothing.
